Subject: Redwood x Catalyst - SI Catalyst Program kickoff?

Hi Kimberly,

Great to meet you at the partner summit last month — thanks again for the intro. Catalyst Consulting has built a short, outcomes-focused onboarding sprint we call the "SI Catalyst Program" that helps consulting partners get to production with a new inference platform in 2–3 weeks. Typical deliverables: integration checklist, one production reference flow, and enablement materials (playbook + labs).

Would Redwood be open to running a pilot sprint with 5 Catalyst consultants and 1 joint customer (Sam Torres, ClientCorp)? Proposed dates: Sep 20–22. Scope we recommend:
- Day 0: prework + environment prep
- Day 1: architecture + model selection deep-dive
- Day 2: hands-on integration labs + runbook handoff

I attached a draft agenda and a sample checklist (see attachments). Can you confirm: 1) Redwood technical leads who'll join, 2) whether you have a preferred prework doc we should align to, and 3) any procurement/legal blockers on our side (we can run under Catalyst NDA/PO if needed).

Thanks — happy to sync tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Aisha Banerjee
Director, Partnerships & Enablement
Catalyst Consulting
Attachments: Catalyst_Onboarding_Sprint_Agenda.pdf, Sample_Checklist.docx

Hi Aisha — thanks, this looks promising. Redwood is interested in a pilot sprint and Sep 20–22 largely works for our team. Quick answers to your questions:

1) Tech leads: Marcus Lin (inference/runtime) and Camila Reyes (solutions engineering) will be the primary technical points. Jordan Blake will support partner ops and logistics.
2) Prework: we have a short "integration readiness" checklist we ask partners to complete; I attached the Redwood-Partner-Checklist.xlsx to this thread. Can you confirm Catalyst consultants can complete it 72 hours before Day 0?
3) Procurement: no major blockers — if you can share a simple SOW or PO, our Partner Ops can fast-track. If you need an NDA, we can route.

Next steps: once you confirm the consultant list and the Customer (Sam Torres), we can lock in calendar invites and send environment access instructions. Also please provide a single slide deck (5–7 slides) with your learning objectives so our enablement team can align.

Kimberly Park
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
